hypothesis.statement: A five-image contract is weak if arbitrary PNGs can satisfy it without proving which MetaHuman, Unreal camera or Editor session produced them.
hypothesis.action: Add an interactive UE 5.6 capture driver that validates the conformed Character, resolves exactly one hero and five named cameras, enforces 50-120mm lenses, renders 1440x2560 and seals camera transforms plus checksums.
hypothesis.expectedResult: The first conformed face can be shown immediately under repeatable conditions and cannot be substituted by unrelated images.

failureHandling: reject missing or duplicate hero/camera actors
reject missing or wrong-class MetaHuman Character
reject lenses outside conversational portrait range
reject image, camera or capture-job provenance drift

qualityBoundary: The runner proves real fixed-view capture provenance, not facial likeness or AAA quality. Human P47 review remains mandatory.
decision: Use these five real images as the first user-visible MetaHuman checkpoint; reject and re-solve if the face remains unattractive or unrecognizable.
